pullRequests.title: Add relocation audit for PAL-native C matches
pullRequests.author: Adrian1845
pullRequests.head: tool/pal-native-reloc-audit
pullRequests.body:
Summary
Add tools/audit_pal_relocs.py to check relocation targets of exact src/pal/ functions after the PAL map is updated. It reuses the existing relocation checker, takes PAL placements from config/pal/map.tsv, resolves shared callees at their address in the caller's level, and reads PAL's $gp (0x2259FF) from the main ELF's .reginfo.
The command accepts specific function names for a new batch or audits every exact PAL-native function after a full C build. It fails on wrong or unresolved…

pullRequests.title: Add 10 near misses that are exact only with inline asm (plzcw, blezl abs)
pullRequests.author: farfeduc
pullRequests.head: decomp/asm-near-misses
pullRequests.body:
Ten main-image functions (each in 14 level places under the same name) compile to retail's bytes, but only with two inline asm helpers. CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/agents/levers.md do not allow inline asm in matched C, so they go to nonmatching/ as near misses, not src/.
Why inline asm

plzcw (leading sign bits, used as floor/ceil log2 of texture sizes): SN 2.95.3 has __builtin_plzcw, but it works on 128-bit values and adds por copies and a sign extension. No C form gives retail's bare plzcw.…
